description: Decode an ISO 10383 Market Identifier Code (MIC) — the 4-character venue code openfigi returns as `exchCode` on an exchange listing, and the code most market-data feeds use the same way — to the trading venue's own name, legal operator, country, city, website and registry status. Reports whether the code is an OPERATING MIC (the operator as a whole, e.g. "XNYS") or a SEGMENT MIC (one specific market under an operator, e.g. "ARCX" under "XNYS"); an operating MIC also carries segment_count — call search_mics with operating_mic to list them.

code.description: 4-character ISO 10383 MIC, e.g. "XNYS" (NYSE) or "XLON" (London Stock Exchange).

name: decode_mic
title: Decode Mic
